subject.title: fix(sessions): keep dirty transcript search from blocking the gateway

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this database-owned generation-claim and dual-watchdog protocol as the canonical dirty transcript-index reconciliation lifecycle?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it establishes new persisted-state meanings, timeout behavior, and process-lifecycle policy in a session-state path where green tests alone cannot establish the intended long-term contract.

options.title: Approve the protocol
options.body: Accept the claim-generation and watchdog design after exact-head packaged proof and required checks confirm the complete upgrade and runtime path.

options.title: Request a narrower lifecycle
options.body: Keep the worker boundary but ask for a simpler owner-approved claim or recovery contract before landing.

recommendation.title: Approve the protocol
recommendation.body: Accept the claim-generation and watchdog design after exact-head packaged proof and required checks confirm the complete upgrade and runtime path.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged history most strongly connects this contributor to current transcript and session-runtime ownership.
